title: Magneton’s Three Magnemite Share One Brain
premise: Magneton links three Magnemite together, gaining electrical power while their three brains become one.
audiencePromise: See why Magneton gets a power boost without becoming three times smarter.
openLoop: What does Magneton gain when three Magnemite link together?
payoff: Magneton is a power upgrade with one shared mind, not three separate minds working together.
engagementQuestion: More power, or three separate minds?

voice.instructions: Warm, quick, and curious. Stress power, one, and not. Pause before each reveal. Sound like a knowledgeable fan sharing a strange fact.

scenes.headline: INTELLIGENCE DOESN’T TRIPLE
scenes.narration: Three Magnemite link up, but intelligence doesn’t triple.
scenes.caption: THREE LINKED. NOT 3X SMARTER.

scenes.headline: THE LINK IS MAGNETIC
scenes.narration: Its three bodies stay linked by a strong magnetic force.
scenes.caption: THREE MAGNEMITE LINK TOGETHER

scenes.headline: POWER DOES TRIPLE
scenes.narration: That link brings about three times Magnemite’s electrical power.
scenes.caption: ABOUT 3X ELECTRICAL POWER

scenes.headline: THREE BRAINS BECOME ONE
scenes.narration: Then the strange part: those three brains become one.
scenes.caption: THREE BRAINS → ONE

scenes.headline: A POWER UPGRADE. ONE MIND.
scenes.narration: The result is a power upgrade with one shared mind.
scenes.caption: MORE POWER. ONE SHARED MIND.

scenes.headline: WHICH WOULD YOU CHOOSE?
scenes.narration: More power, or three separate minds?
scenes.caption: POWER OR SEPARATE MINDS?
